maps.points.surroundings_cave.dialogue: The cavern yawns open, its floor broken into heaps of jagged stone and drifting dust. It feels as though something powerful tore the chamber apart with intent.
maps.points.surroundings_cave.dialogue-1: Something like huge beetles... You've never seen prints like these in your life.
Choose “Wait. Let me sense whether the dead have touched this place.”
At first, nothing beyond the usual silence of dead vermin and the old remains of hunted beasts.
Then you feel it. The presence of higher undead. But not as you know it. Not cold, not bound in the wrong way.
This feels altered. Twisted into something unfamiliar... something you have never encountered before.
Choose “Give me a moment. If there's a trap here, I'll find it.”
You study the floor, the walls, the broken edges of stone, searching for wires, pressure plates, hidden slots, any sign of a prepared kill.
Nothing. No trapwork. No mechanism. No human hand in this.
Choose “Wait. Let me see what the dark is hiding.”
You narrow your eyes and peer into the dark, letting instinct do what torchlight cannot.
maps.points.surroundings_cave.dialogue-2: As the echoes fade, another sound threads through the dripping water and shifting rubble. A faint chittering. Mandibles clicking in the dark. Steady gnaw of creatures just out of sight.
Nothing answers. No heat, no movement, no hidden shape waiting just beyond the rubble.
Whatever made this mess is either gone... or unlike anything your senses were meant to catch.
Subsequent dialogue (Task "Wards of the West" is not ongoing)
The symbols are ancient. Most are shattered by the fall. What fragments remain, you cannot read.
Subsequent dialogue (Task "Wards of the West" is in progress)
You recall Khelebar's request to copy the runes carved into the stone.
Much has been destroyed, but you carefully record the surviving lines onto parchment.
You have already copied what little could be salvaged from the broken runes.
The last shell cracks under your boot, the skittering gone. The rock gives way to a hollow chamber where the fallen obelisk lies.
Its stone wasn't simply smashed by the fall. It has been worn down, chewed away slowly, like marrow pulled from a bone. Tunnels web the walls, a patient map of hunger.
maps.points.surroundings_cave.dialogue-3: This swarm didn't wander. It dug with purpose.

maps.points.surroundings_cave.dialogue-6: "Wait. Let me see what the dark is hiding." (Requires Dwarf)
maps.points.surroundings_cave.dialogue-8: You crouch near the shattered stone, brushing dust aside with two fingers.
maps.points.surroundings_cave.dialogue-9: Tracks. Dozens of them. Tiny legs, close together, etched in frantic patterns across the rubble.
